title: CBSP21-DIAG-001 / BR-046: report no applicable manifest on zero-overlap auto-discovery
intent: Authorized repair for BR-046. When auto-discovery finds changed files but no candidate manifest covers any of them, select_manifest returns None and both CBSP21 gates fail closed with an actionable no-applicable-manifest diagnostic instead of naming an unrelated historical manifest at 0% coverage. Empty diffs and explicit --manifest behavior are preserved. Enforcement threshold (95%) and fail-closed semantics are unchanged.
behavior_change: none intended for application/runtime. Governance tooling diagnostics only: zero-overlap auto-discovery no longer attributes failure to a stale manifest path. Exit codes remain non-zero for uncovered / missing-manifest patches.

diff_articulation.what_changed: (1) select_manifest: empty non-internal changed-file signal keeps deterministic selection; non-empty signal with max overlap 0 returns None. (2) check_cbsp21_gate.resolve_manifest and check_cbsp21_patch_input fail with no-applicable-manifest guidance when selection is None. (3) Unit tests characterize zero-overlap / partial / empty boundaries. (4) README + docs/CBSP21.md document the three discovery outcomes. (5) BR-046 register/ledger moved to IMPLEMENTED — AWAITING MERGE under CBSP21-DIAG-001.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Implements the authorized repair for BR-046 (#260 intake). Intake explicitly did not change tooling; this sprint is the diagnostic correction without weakening fail-closed enforcement.
